speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You burned three candles to the socket Tuesday. Three! I heard you walking. Was it the lovers again?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Tuesday was the tooth. The lovers were this morning. They burned one.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: And did they part?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: At sunrise.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then they've more sense than you.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: One candle is still a candle, Mistress. The socket in his room was black when I went up.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: One. I am not arguing Tuesday's count. She has it. Three is three.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Mark me. Three on Tuesday for a tooth, and one this morning for a girl and a boy who had the wit to part. I heard the walking. I did not hear a lark.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: There is no lark in Great St Helen's in October. There are rooks. She said it was the nightingale. She was lying, and then he stayed because she asked.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then he has less sense than I just allowed him. Eat the soft side. The left of your face is past bread.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The sheet runs to the nurse at the door. Eighty lines. I am not going to speak them over the mutton.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The loaf is a penny, and a full thumb short of the notch. I did not call it two fingers.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Threepence the meal. You will not make the board dearer by having written a sunrise. You are out at two.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not pricing the dawn. Twelve pence is the tooth, on Tuesday, at ten, and it is not paid. I am not cast on Tuesday afternoon. That is his hour, and I took it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You will keep the hour. I will not have you clever about Tuesday the way the candles were nearly clever about you.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will keep it. He named it. Today I am in the Roman at two, off in the fourth if it goes as it went, and then the share, and then the house.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The clove-wool was in the saucer when the light came. I left it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The cloves stopped answering yesterday. The wool can sit. If the jaw wants anything tonight, it will be aquavitae on a clout, and that is after I am home.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: After the Roman, then. Eat. They have parted. You have not, from this table, until the plate is clear. Threepence, and I have said so.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Gib, the wool is not a mouse. Off the board.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The soft side is the side I cut. A penny, and the thumb still short. I am not calling it dearer because you were up at grey light.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Grey light is not a price. One candle, eighty lines, and they parted. That is the morning. The Roman is the afternoon.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then finish the plate before you are a Roman. Three on Tuesday. One today. I have said both, and I will not say them as one number.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Both, and not one number. I am out at two. I will be back when the share is said. The jaw can have the aquavitae after, and not at this board.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: After. And if the wool is still in that saucer when you come down, Gib is not to be trusted with it. I have spoken to the cat. The cat has not agreed.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I will move the saucer to the sill if he tries again. The wool stays. You said the cloves had stopped.
